'''Nuked nachos''' are an easy-to-prepare, quick microwaved side dish, great with a quick-made lunch or such.

==Ingredients==
*About ⅓–½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (80–120 g) [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (diced, grated, pre-melted, or similar)
*Corn chips or [[Cookbook:Tortilla Chip|tortilla chips]]

==Procedure==
#Spread the chips on a [[Cookbook:Microwave|microwave]]-safe plate, and scatter the cheese on top.
#Top the chips with any other desired microwave-safe toppings.
#Microwave for 30 seconds, or until the cheese has melted. If the cheese melts onto the plate, just rip it off the plate and put it on the nachos.
#Eat while hot!

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Other chips that are good as nachos will work too.
* Try topping with cooked ground meat and/or peppers.
